CommonMark / GFM conformance observations
========================================

This file records the current instrument output, not a passing threshold.
Run flutter test test/core/spec to regenerate build/reports/*.json.
The report includes every source, expected HTML, actual HTML and example ID.
Parse exceptions and invalid source spans fail the tests; HTML differences do not.

CommonMark 0.31.2: 564/652 exact HTML matches (86.5%).
GFM 0.29 extension examples: 19/27 (70.4%).

Intentional policy differences
-----------------------------
- Raw HTML is parsed into a safe native subset instead of copied verbatim.
  Unknown tag shells are removed; script/style/iframe bodies are discarded;
  comments are removed; attributes are filtered; unclosed tags are balanced.
  Complete HTML documents export as escaped code. This also affects examples
  outside the HTML sections (links, emphasis, lists and line breaks).
- The HTML serializer allows only http, https, mailto, tel and file schemes
  plus selected base64 image data. Other schemes lose the destination.
- Strikethrough requires double tildes; GFM example 491 accepts single tildes.
- Task input attributes and XHTML closing syntax differ from GFM examples
  279 and 280; checkbox state and list nesting agree.

Known implementation gaps (not claimed as deliberate dialect choices)
-------------------------------------------------------------------
- Trailing whitespace at the end of paragraphs/setext headings is retained
  (CommonMark 82, 89, 226, 645).
- Reference definitions immediately before setext delimiters are not removed
  before heading recognition (215, 216). Unicode reference-label matching
  uses lowercase, not complete Unicode case folding (540).
- Empty list items followed by blank lines can absorb a following paragraph
  (280). Blank lines at nested-list boundaries do not always mark the parent
  list loose (325, 326). Empty loose items have an extra HTML newline (315).
- URL serialization retains square brackets, including outside IPv6 hosts;
  the reference HTML percent-encodes those brackets (526, 538, 603).
- GFM bare-link scanning does not yet trim a trailing entity-like ampersand
  suffix (627), accept one-character email domain suffixes (632), or include
  explicit mailto/xmpp prefixes and XMPP resources (633-635).
